svg.title: Fictional cases: what can each person choose?
svg.desc: Person A has a task, then can choose to visit relatives. Person B must continue required household service and cannot freely choose to leave. Both have duties but different stated restrictions. The fictional cases do not establish exact historical titles.

g.text: Fictional cases: what can each person choose?
Has a task at the gathering
Both have duties; their stated choices differ.
These cases do not supply enough detail for exact historical titles.
Compare conditions and sources. Social position does not measure human worth.
